name: disprove-guarded-upstream
description: One claim is true (parse_limit crashes on None); the other misses the membership check in get_account, the only caller of load_account

findings.body: `load_account` dereferences `record["payload"]` when `store.get` returns None, raising TypeError for an unknown account id.
`parse_limit` calls `.strip()` on its argument, so a missing query parameter (None) raises AttributeError instead of a validation error.
